# QivaLabs

> QivaLabs LLP is a software, mobile app, website and AI development company based in Udaipur, India. It builds custom software, mobile apps, websites, SaaS products, AI agents and automation for startups and businesses in the USA, UK, Australia, Europe and the UAE, as well as India. Contact: sales@qivalabs.com, +91 72318 73730.
